findings.resolution: Reworded build_15 to «четыре состояния обычной партии», added a fifth comparison-table row for WON pointing at 19.18, and added an info callout stating plainly that GameStatus has five members and cross-linking 19.18 and 19.21. The notebook and grader were deliberately left as a four-state exercise, which is now consistent with how the section frames them.
